box.title: Please Support Shareware!
box.text: I wrote this program for myself, and for those of you who have to stare at a computer screen all day long. We are told that we should blink once every six seconds. Studies have shown that when watching television we blink much less than that. When looking at a computer screen, we blink even less still. This lack of blinking can lead to permanant drying and damage to the eye surface. Now you can stop this process. Just blink each time the eyes pop up and blink, and enjoy your healthy, happy eyes! I have made this program freely available through shareware so that the largest number of people will be able to use it. If you do use this product, you are obligated to pay me for time that it took to create it.
